NOT ACCEPTED. The suite is green and the gate has only ONE new violation, but two findings your own reviewer filed as P2 residual are, on controller measurement, disqualifying. Both were reproduced first-hand, not taken from the report.

BLOCKING 1 - you introduced a silent data-loss path into escalations.md, the artifact this slice exists to make trustworthy. _read_text swallows OSError and returns the empty string, and _place_escalation does `body = _read_text(path) or ESCALATIONS_HEADER`, so a page that EXISTS but cannot be read is replaced by a fresh header plus one section. Controller reproduction, using the module's own API: a page built to three sections (912 bytes) was reduced to one section (370 bytes) after a read failure, s1/s2/s3 gone, and place_escalation RAISED NOTHING. This is a regression against the base, where the escalation-opened branch used _append_text, which never reads and never truncates. FIX: distinguish 'file absent' (fine - create it) from 'read failed' (must NOT overwrite - propagate the error or abort the placement). An empty read must never be treated as an empty page. Add a regression test that reproduces exactly the scenario above.

BLOCKING 2 - section identity is computed from the TRUNCATED render, so it is unsound for the majority of real records. _escalation_identity compares the rendered '- Context:' and '- The decision:' lines, which render_escalation has already passed through _one_line(..., 400). Two genuinely distinct rounds whose contexts agree on their first ~399 characters therefore collide as 'the same question', which loses the newer round's context and options and can drop the earlier round's recorded answer. Reachability, controller-measured across the recorded corpus: 7 of 12 escalation-opened payloads carry contexts longer than 400 characters (445, 445, 489, 551, 560, 621, 652), and the quality-gate-block context is a newline-joined findings list whose rounds differ near the tail - so this is the common case, not an edge. It also falsifies your own docstring's stated guarantee, which is this run's named defect class.

SCOPE CLARIFICATION, because your reviewer believed the ceiling forbade the fix: it does not. Compute identity from the RAW record fields - its id, context and question, whitespace-collapsed if you like - instead of from rendered lines. That requires NO change to any truncation limit, so the 'do not refactor run_state.py's truncation limits' ceiling is untouched and this fix is IN SCOPE. Do not change the 400s.

BLOCKING 3 - the one genuinely new gate violation: append_event in run_state.py now takes 5 parameters against a threshold of 4. Fix it behaviour-preservingly; do not weaken the threshold. The two class_lines findings (run_state.py 1023, test_run_state.py 1528) remain ACCEPTED pre-existing debt - controller-measured, both files were already over the bar at the run base - so do not split either file and do not spend a round on them.

ACCURACY NOTE: your sidecar's quality detail claims '8 violations across nesting_depth, parameter_count, and class_lines'. Controller measurement of your worktree at a7b4812 finds exactly THREE, and none on nesting_depth. Report measured numbers; an overstated violation count is the same defect class this run is fixing.

Everything else in your diff stands, including the true-identity design, the dropped stickiness and the INTG-7 citation fix. Your three refutations were adjudicated and are not reopened.
